## The problem

Guest satisfaction results lived in a data platform that most of the team did
not query directly, so following them meant exporting and rebuilding reports by
hand.

## What I did

- Connected Power BI live to Databricks through DirectQuery, so the dashboard
  always shows current data.
- Built the data model, DAX measures and Power Query steps behind the report.
- Designed the report so the team can follow satisfaction results in one place.

## Results

The dashboard is used by multiple teams, from analysts to executives, as
their shared view of guest satisfaction results.

## What I learned

Live connections are powerful but come with trade-offs. With DirectQuery, every
click sends a query, so measure design and model structure matter a lot more
for performance than they do with imported data.
